title: Arctiva — Linux, without the barriers.
description: Arctiva is an Arch Linux–based distribution with a graphical installer, KDE Plasma, automatic snapshots and gaming out of the box.
lead: A Linux distribution based on Arch Linux: the official Arch repositories and rolling releases, with a graphical installer, a familiar desktop and safe updates.
about_p: Arctiva keeps the official Arch Linux repositories, pacman and the rolling-release model, and adds what makes it easy to start using.

features.p: Official Arch repositories, pacman and rolling releases.
Calamares, with Basic, Gaming and Office profiles.
A desktop that feels close to what Windows users already know.
Btrfs + Snapper snapshots taken automatically and bootable from GRUB.
Games and graphics drivers ready to use.

status_done_p: Live ISO with KDE Plasma and an installer with Basic, Gaming and Office profiles, Btrfs with snapshots, optional encryption and installation alongside Windows. Tested in virtual machines.
status_wip_p: Arctiva Center (welcome, updates, drivers, extras). Our own signed repository [arctiva] is already published.
status_noiso: There is no ISO to download yet: coming soon. In the meantime, you can build it from the source code.
reqs: 64-bit x86 PC with UEFI (Secure Boot disabled)
GPU with Vulkan support for gaming

roadmap.t: Polish and testing on real hardware.

legal_independent: Arctiva is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Arch Linux.
